indications: Mupirocin ointment 2% is indicated for the topical treatment of impetigo due to: Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pyogenes.
contraindications: A small amount of mupirocin ointment should be applied to the affected area three times daily. The area treated may be covered with a gauze dressing if desired. Patients not showing a clinical response within 3 to 5 days should be reevaluated.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Mupirocin Ointment USP, 2% is supplied in 22 gram tubes.
                  Store at 20o to 25oC (68o to 77oF) [See USP Controlled Room Temperature].
